blueprints.promptProse: Sora Kasugano sits on a shaded shrine step to fasten the strap of one Mary Jane shoe. A slate-blue pinafore covers her white long-sleeved blouse, and the rabbit plush rests safely against a cloth bag beside her. She glances back toward the moving tree shadows before brushing a tiny leaf from the skirt. Soft green-reflected daylight reveals white twin tails, black ribbons and quiet grey eyes in a close, fully clothed everyday portrait.

blueprints.promptProse: Sora Kasugano from Yosuga no Sora wears a simple white bridal dress with a narrow ribbon veil, lace cuffs and a small rabbit charm.
